The indirect relationship through Infliximab, a TNF inhibitor, highlights a potential mechanism where Etanercept could influence the inflammatory cascade that leads to Ankylosing Spondylitis. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, supported by the overlapping indications and the shared biological mechanism of TNF-alpha inhibition.
